{{Quote|Drako, the leader of the Hawk-bat gang.|[[Oollie]], introducing Drako|<ref name="AA" />}}
'''Drako''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Codru-Ji]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Drako became a professional [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] early in life, and was said to have never lost a race. His winning streaks were helped in part by his trusty [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] that never left his side. Drako eventually became leader of the notorious [[Hawkbat Gang]], a swoop racing group founded in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underlevels]] during the years following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

===Last race===
{{Quote|I challenge you to a race through the tunnel near the power plant. Meet me in one hour.''"<br />"''You're on.''"<br />"''Don't be late, Jedi.|Drako and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AA" />}}
[[File:Anakin-and-Oollie.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Drako challenge Skywalker which turned out to be his last race.]]
Sometime after [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Drako set up a swoop race on Coruscant, challenging the young and talented [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Midway through the course, Drako realized that he could not defeat Anakin, without the help of his blaster, that is. While aiming his weapon, he became distracted and failed to notice the obstacle in his way. Slamming into a [[Repulsorlift transport/Legends|repulsorlift transport]], Drako was killed instantly.<ref name="AA" />

==Personality and traits==
Drako was a member of the four-armed Codru-Ji species and one of the fastest racers on Coruscant. Prior to his death, Drako was undefeated; most believed this was due to cheating.<ref name="AA" />
